summary: Nutrition Phase 2 (Barcode) tested end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass (auth, validation, OFF live lookup, 30-day cache hit, 1-day negative cache, scaled log-from-barcode, favourites insertion, servings & barcode validation, unknown-product 404, food/search min-length + shape). Frontend: verified full web manual-entry flow (BARCODE action w/o SOON pill → /nutrition/barcode manual input → Coca-Cola review card w/ correct macros 139/0/35/0 kcal @1x, 209/0/53/0 @1.5x, MEAL TYPE + SAVE AS FAVOURITE + LOG MEAL → navigates back to /nutrition and totals update; unknown-barcode not-found screen → LOG MANUALLY prefills notes with 'Barcode 0000000000001' and pre-toggles Save-as-Favourite via ?barcode= param; SCAN ANOTHER resets to manual phase). One spec deviation noted (informational only, not a bug).

minor.issue: Spec assumed this barcode would return found:false, but Open Food Facts has a real (test) entry 'Salatgurke' at that code. Backend behaves correctly — it caches and returns the OFF product. Adjust spec or use a longer/rarer barcode (e.g. 99999999999999) for the negative-cache test. Backend test was updated accordingly.

action_items: (Optional) Add testIDs to the + / – circular servings buttons and the servings-value display in /app/frontend/app/nutrition/barcode.tsx so future automated tests can assert 1x→1.25x→1.75x transitions deterministically. Screenshot verification confirmed the buttons render and the 0.5x/1x/1.5x/2x chips work — only automation coverage is affected.
critical_code_review_comments: feature_nutrition_barcode.py cleanly separates provider abstraction (nutritionix stub + open_food_facts) and cache — good design. Negative results cached for 1 day, positive for 30 days as spec requires.
log_from_barcode correctly guards servings (0<s<=20) and barcode format, and scales macros by mult with proper rounding (int kcal, 1-dec macros).
Frontend barcode.tsx correctly initialises phase='manual' on web (Platform.OS==='web') and shows the web note; scanAgain() also resets to 'manual' on web — matches spec.
log.tsx correctly reads ?barcode= via useLocalSearchParams and prefills notes + saveAsFav=true when present — matches spec.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests reuse seeded client@crewfit.com. Real Open Food Facts lookups were performed for 5449000000996 (Coca-Cola); one nutrition_logs row + one nutrition_favourites row were written during test_log_from_barcode_success and are left in the DB (marked source='barcode').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 barcode scanner (manual-entry web flow) fully validated iter 38. Native camera flow (CameraView + expo-camera onBarcodeScanned) is NOT testable in Playwright web preview — do not attempt. Backend live-tests against Open Food Facts; be aware OFF has test entries at some 'obvious' barcodes (e.g. 9999999999999). Use 14-digit random codes for negative tests.
